title: Odoo - ERP Consultant
description:
**Role Description**
The Odoo - ERP Consultant will be responsible for overseeing the implementation, configuration, and optimization of Odoo ERP modules to support manufacturing, supply chain, and finance operations. This full-time, on-site role in Neemrana involves analyzing existing business processes, gathering requirements from stakeholders, and translating them into effective ERP workflows and solutions. The consultant will manage end-to-end ERP implementations, including system setup, data migration, integration, testing, and go-live support. Daily tasks include collaborating with cross-functional teams, creating functional documentation, training end-users, and providing ongoing support to ensure system stability and continuous improvement. The role also includes monitoring ERP performance, identifying process gaps, and recommending enhancements aligned with organizational goals.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Business Process knowledge, with the ability to map, document, and optimize workflows in a manufacturing environment.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills for requirement gathering, problem-solving, and translating operational challenges into effective ERP configurations.
* Candidates should possess hands-on experience in ERP Implementations and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), preferably with Odoo in production or manufacturing settings.
* Candidates should possess a good understanding of Finance processes, including basic accounting, cost control, and integration of financial data within ERP systems.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related fields.
* Ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, with clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience in manufacturing or industrial domains and familiarity with supply chain and inventory management is highly beneficial.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently on-site at the Neemrana facility.

title: New Product Development Manager
description:
**Who we need? – NPD (New Product Development) Manager**

- We are seeking an innovative and strategic NPD Manager to lead the development of new products/projects.

- This role is key to expanding our product portfolio, improving existing products, and driving innovation aligned with market trends and customer demands.

**What will an NPD Manager do?**

- Lead and manage end-to-end new product development projects, from concept to commercialization.

- Collaborate with the R&D, design, production, quality, and marketing teams to bring new hardware fitting products to life.

- Conduct market research to identify customer needs, industry trends, and competitor activities, and use these insights to develop innovative product solutions.

- Develop project plans, timelines, budgets, and resource allocations to ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.

- Oversee the prototyping, testing, and validation processes for new designs, ensuring products meet functional, aesthetic, and safety standards.

- Ensure all new products comply with quality, regulatory, and industry standards.

- Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to support product launches and create technical documentation, presentations, and selling tools.

- Analyze product performance and customer feedback post-launch to drive continuous improvement.

- Establish and maintain strong relationships with vendors, material suppliers, and technology partners.

- Promote a culture of innovation and improvement within the NPD team.

- Monitor progress, track KPIs, and report regularly to senior management on NPD performance and outcomes.

**An efficient NPD Manager should have:**

- Strong knowledge of hardware fittings, materials (such as metal alloys, zinc, brass), and manufacturing processes like casting, forging, machining, polishing, coating, etc.

- Proven project management skills and experience managing cross-functional teams.

- Deep understanding of product development lifecycle, from idea to commercialization.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent organizational, leadership, and communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively.

- A passion for innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction.

**Minimum Education Requirements:**

- Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

- Minimu 8 - 10 years of experience in product development within a manufacturing environment, preferably in metal components.

- Prior experience in leading NPD teams and launching successful products.

Location: Neemrana, Rajasthan

**Job Type: Full-time**

**Workplace: In-office**

**Salary: Can be discussed**

**﻿
Working Hours: as per company need.**
